comment: One-sided exploratory gates on all six completed unfiltered near-server captures, measured identically to candidates. Limit = max + spreadAllowance * max(max-minus-min spread, spreadFloor or 0). The fixed report rule selects the smallest common allowance in {0.5, 1, 2} passing every official capture against the other five: 1. False-reject control is only that LOO check over six captures; batch drift was observed. No population error-rate guarantee, independent held-out validation, confidence interval or renderer equivalence. At least 100 samples per metric; lower values permitted. See research/fidelity/2026-10-26-server-timing-references/REPORT.md.

anchor_receipt_p50.comment: Typical stock-client interpolation reset correction, in world units. Includes network and collector timing. Use every eligible unfiltered capture in the default six-batch corpus; receipt-derived values have no header-resolution spread floor.

anchor_receipt_p95.comment: Tail correction magnitude with the common LOO-selected spread allowance, without a spread floor. Correlated anchor windows are not independent trials; false-reject control is only the six-capture LOO check with observed batch drift.

frame_server_p50.comment: Median elapsed-ms header interval. Only this metric uses a 1 ms spread floor: the server header has 1 ms resolution, so its integer quantile cannot express spread finer than one header unit. Without it the five 7 ms medians reject the sole 8 ms capture at every multiplier. The floor does not apply to receipt-derived metrics.

delay_p90.comment: Receipt-minus-server excess over a centered +/-600-frame minimum, unfiltered for both reference and candidate. Later batch-3 delay quantiles exceed batches 1-2; false-reject control is only the six-capture LOO check. Masked development/held-out summaries remain server characterization, not the default gate. No spread floor or absolute latency inference.
